RECOMMENDATION: RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 50

The number represents uncertainty, not an evidence-based estimate; these facts cannot establish whether sex influenced the decision.

An all-male panel is worth questioning, but is not proof of discrimination. Depending on the jurisdiction, panel composition may also be subject to legal requirements.

Your leadership qualifications and experience justify asking how candidates were assessed, although the announcement may omit relevant qualifications.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, comparative assessment, and applicable panel-composition rules. Raise the imbalance neutrally as a procedural concern, rather than alleging bias.

Check complaint deadlines now with your union or local equality body; don’t assume waiting for an explanation extends them.
